title: Locating Information Gaps and Narrative Inconsistencies Across Languages: A Case Study of LGBT People Portrayals on Wikipedia

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing factual coverage and sentiment disparities in Wikipedia biographies by fitting a Bayesian binomial regression model to measure how an individual's LGBT affiliation affects the cross-lingual inclusion of positive, negative, and neutral facts.

Using the INFOGAP method to automatically decompose, align, and verify fact-level equivalence across English, French, and Russian Wikipedia editions to quantify cross-lingual information gaps, narrative inconsistencies, and framing differences.
